$comment: DSH-only hooks, merged into the generated .dsh/hooks.json by tools/build-dsh.mjs.
These have no upstream original: they replace an upstream mechanism that DSH
does not have, or adapt a DSGS instruction to DSH's tool surface.
Commands are project-relative, like the ported DSGS hooks.
Advisory reroute. Upstream raises these two as PreToolUse advisories, and DSH never
surfaces a pre-execute systemMessage (the bridge maps only deny/ask there), so the
model never saw them. The same scripts are registered a second time here, where
additionalContext IS delivered — a commit or push that just happened is still the
right moment to hear about a TODO, a hardcoded value or a protected branch.
The PreToolUse registrations stay: that is where they can still BLOCK.
